mission: Ask for what you need at the hotel
missionTr: Otelde isteklerini söyle: erken giriş, manzaralı oda, uyandırma servisi, ekstra havlu, geç çıkış

words.example: Could I have a late check-out?
Could I have a room with a view?
I'd like a quiet room, please.
Could I have extra towels, please?
Is room service available at night?
words.exampleTr: Oda servisi gece de var mı?

words.example: I'd like a wake-up call at seven.
Is there a safe in the room?

pronounce.tipTr: "Quite" (oldukça) ile karıştırma: quiet iki hecedir, KUAY-ıt.
Lüks oda anlamındaki suite "sviit" diye okunur, tatlı (sweet) gibi.

recognize.audio: Your room will be ready at three p.m.
recognize.prompt: Listen. When can you go to your room?
recognize.explainTr: Three p.m. = öğleden sonra 3. ABD'de saatler genelde a.m./p.m. ile söylenir.

recognize.prompt: You want to sleep well. You ask for a…
recognize.explainTr: Quiet = sessiz. Asansörden ve caddeden uzak bir oda istersin.

recognize.audio: A room with a view is forty dollars extra per night.
recognize.prompt: Listen. What does the extra cost pay for?
recognize.explainTr: "Forty dollars extra per night" = gecelik 40 dolar fazladan.

use.phrase: Could I have a wake-up call at seven?
use.phraseTr: Saat yedide uyandırma servisi alabilir miyim?
use.situation: You have an early tour tomorrow. Ask the hotel to wake you at seven.
use.situationTr: Yarın erken bir turun var. Otelden seni saat yedide uyandırmasını iste.
